descriptions.value: 美容院职员曾小雨机缘巧合之下，认识了富豪之子利志，以为交上好运。岂料利志的父亲是茅山高人，在南洋大败一降头师时，被下咒绝子绝孙，让利志每次恋爱皆遭恶鬼破坏，无疾而终。小雨深爱利志，找大法师沈慈航帮助，授以五色驱邪带，两人顺利结婚。新婚之夜，利志遗失了驱邪彩带，果然恶鬼来犯...
摄影师陈志成长年被一名「红衣女子」纠缠，导致多位亲人惨死；甚至连自己心仪的女孩思桐亦难逃恶运。志成欲寻找思桐惨死的真相，却揭发关于一场「冥婚」的秘密...

titles.value: 非法移民 / The Illegal Immigrant

descriptions.value: 改编自真实个案，交织着年青偷渡客的友谊、爱情与理想的梦。青年张君秋偷渡纽约，一方面要筹钱还给偷渡集团，另一方面希望通过假结婚获得居留权，故不断找寻假结婚对象。

titles.value: 无间道 II / Infernal Affairs II

descriptions.value: 《无间道》的秘密最终在此前传中揭露 — 重案组督察黄志诚与黑帮头领韩琛的恩怨和两名卧底陈永仁与刘建明的宿命纠缠何时开始。关键原来系于三个人身上：琛妻、新任黑帮龙头及重案组高层。无间之门亦在这最坏的时代敞开…

titles.value: 看不见的他们 / Never Leave

descriptions.value: 一场车祸后，林月家里怪事连连。全身冰冷的姐姐在镜子里看不见家人的身影，黑夜里爸爸窥探的双眼，和每天凌晨阁楼传来的弹珠声。林月循声而上去寻找真相，却在打开阁楼的门后，发现里面紧锁的是自己的遗像…

titles.value: 反收数特遣队 / Shark Busters

descriptions.value: 在金融危机期间，绝大多数香港市民陷入债务困境。此时，贵利集团采取无情手段逼迫债务人还款，李探员与其地下部队誓言缉拿这个非法组织的头目。

titles.value: 千王斗千霸 / Challenge of the Gamesters

descriptions.value: 名震赌坛的千王与其拍档受命调查一位上海赌界大亨，怀疑其以赌场为掩护从事间谍活动。两人深入危机四伏的赌局世界，在层层布局与试探中步步为营，与强敌展开一场关乎生死与荣耀的斗智对决。
地下拳手林枫因拒绝替曼谷黑帮打黑拳，因此被追杀。他虽成功逃脱，却失去记忆。当林枫开展其新生活时，却被黑帮发现行踪，并找来绝顶打手对付他。期间林枫忽然回复记忆，并誓要将黑帮歼灭。

titles.value: 少年陈真之乱世英雄 / Young Heroes of Chaotic Times

descriptions.value: 电影讲述清末上海的小人物陈真，在经历苦难及面对无数挑战后，蜕变成长为民族英雄的故事。

titles.value: 花心大少 / Hong Kong Playboys

descriptions.value: 严钱声是一名自恃追女高手的富家花花公子，被母亲劝喻要成家立室。他在寻找生命中的女主角时，被两个追女高手挑战。到底他最后能否找到心中最爱?
这是一场发生在三国动荡时期的史诗式之旅。曹操试图招揽关羽加入他的阵营，但关羽忠于他的结拜兄弟刘备，也是曹操的敌人。当关羽试图从曹操手上救出刘备的小妾时，迫于无奈要大开杀戒。最后他能否杀出重围？

titles.value: 国产凌凌漆 / From Beijing With Love

descriptions.value: 一名被重新启用的后备中国特工伪装成猪肉贩，意外被派去追回被盗的恐龙头骨。他被派往香港，并在一名暗中为反派效力的女特工协助下展开行动。两人在重重背叛与危机中应对挑战，最终对抗幕后黑手，成功夺回国宝并揭露阴谋。

titles.value: 风云雄霸天下 / The Stormriders

descriptions.value: 十年前，笃信命理的「天下会」霸主雄霸请来泥菩萨推算命运。泥菩萨预言，若想称霸武林，必须收两位名字分别带有「风」与「云」的少年为徒，他们将助他成就霸业，也将左右他一生的命运。霸业虽成，预言却骤然逆转，一场由批言引发的武林浩劫，彻底改变了整个武林的命运。

titles.value: 无敌幸运星 / When Fortune Smiles

descriptions.value: 富翁死前立下遗嘱，把财富全留给女儿飞飞，逼使其子秋少及侄儿大傻设法分一杯羹。大傻派小混混幸运星往偷遗嘱，欲在遗嘱上做手脚，而秋少亦找来貌似其妹的阿凤假扮飞飞骗取遗嘱。幸运星打算骗”假飞飞”结婚以夺取遗产，不料二人日久生情，最终幸运星在婚礼日揭发二人的诡计。

titles.value: 倾城之恋 / Love in a Fallen City

descriptions.value: 本片由香港导演许鞍华执导，改编自著名小说家张爱玲的同名小说，是一个发生在日军入侵香港期间的爱情故事。一个内向的上海离婚女子和一个愤世嫉俗的马来西亚花花公子互相倾慕。但因时局动荡，两人多次被迫分开，最终能否有情人终成眷属?

titles.value: 倾城之恋 / Love in a Fallen City

descriptions.value: 本片由香港导演许鞍华执导，改编自著名小说家张爱玲的同名小说，是一个发生在日军入侵香港期间的爱情故事。一个内向的上海离婚女子和一个愤世嫉俗的马来西亚花花公子互相倾慕。但因时局动荡，两人多次被迫分开，最终能否有情人终成眷属?
三名持枪劫匪抢劫了一批正在运送的新发行货币，刑警常勇奉命展开调查。随着线索逐渐浮现，常勇成功击毙一名劫匪。然而，其他两名劫匪不甘就此罢手，乘乱密谋抢劫金厂的黄金。常勇凭借精密的部署，成功粉碎了他们的计划，将不法分子绳之以法。
书生王怀卿卖画，为要筹药费救患重病的妻子，途中意外遇上雀妖的追击，幸得狐妖小容相救。为躲避雀妖，王怀卿将小容带回家中，三人随即陷入一场情感困局，而一段凄美的人妖虐恋亦随即展开。

titles.value: 贼王之王 / Winner Takes All

descriptions.value: 两名私家侦探欲藉破一连环大劫案而声名大噪。岂料调查过程中竟一再被贼王使计愚弄，笑话连篇。及后更发现原来所有劫案均与日商宫本有关，到底谁才是真正的贼王之王？

titles.value: 女特警之暗战 / Hidden Heroine

descriptions.value: 东州地区长期盘踞一支贩毒集团。霹雳女子突击队队员梅静率领其他队员成功攻入贩毒集团的制毒基地，却中了预先设下的埋伏，梅爸爸是犯罪集团内部的卧底身份亦随之暴露。最后，梅静与突击队员们经历一轮激战后，击败对手，并救出梅爸爸。
依成和朋友到聚魂灵山探险，传说山中埋着千年女尸，千年不灭之阴火，进去的人都逃不出来。凌晨两点半，依成的朋友先后突然消失。在森林搜索期间，依成进入无限轮回的灵异空间，更恐怖的事情却接踵而来…

titles.value: 赤脚小子 / The Bare-footed Kid

descriptions.value: 穷乡青年关丰曜，终日赤着双脚，以背人过河为活。关父临终前，嘱其出城投靠段青云；段骤见故人之子，留下关在布店当小工。关与私塾女教师华小莲交心，却遭莲父白眼；关为求出人头地，竟往投靠土霸喀和布，结果连累莲父与段相继被喀暗算身亡。关得知真相，惜为时已晚，追悔莫及，决与喀拼过死活...

titles.value: 珠光宝气 / Whatever You Want

descriptions.value: 一名商人的私生女，无意中擦出神仙阿宝，并得到三个愿望。可惜阿宝法术不精，而发生了很多啼笑皆非的事。

titles.value: 冰封侠之时空行者 / Iceman the Time Traveller

descriptions.value: 《冰封侠：时空行者》承接前作，四位明朝锦衣卫在现代香港苏醒。为修正历史，贺英独自踏上了寻找「时空金球」的凶险旅程，却不知自己正一步步堕入精心布下的致命陷阱。

titles.value: 我爱神仙遮 / My Darling Genie

descriptions.value: 推土车司机阿成，在工作时忽遇地陷而堕入一地下古庙，无意中成为油纸伞妖的主人。她更将自己现身的秘密及超凡的法力告知阿成。地盘工目凡叔嗜赌，欠下恶少高利贷，恶少垂涎凡叔之女美色，要凡叔以女还债；阿成得悉后请伞妖戏弄恶少，并暗助凡叔在赌场获胜，清还债项。惟此神伞之秘密却被恶少发现…

titles.value: 霍家拳之精武英雄 / Fist of Legend

descriptions.value: 陈真奉师命赴日求学，因解救并爱上校友山田广子，就此陷入日本黑龙会的权力纷争。面对华人学生接连失踪、黑龙会渗透打压精武门，他连手热血青年梁少文深入敌营，捣毁秘密实验室并瓦解阴谋，与强敌展开生死决战，誓死守护民族尊严。
这是关于香港消防员的英勇救火故事。勇敢的消防员无惧冲天大火，肩负救灾扶危的重任，甚至舍身救人。但当消防员脱下制服后，是否仍同样勇敢地面对自身的难题呢？

titles.value: 消失的子弹 / The Bullet Vanishes

descriptions.value: 民国初年，一家兵工厂发生离奇连环命案。死者皆死于枪击，现场却遍寻不到弹头，引发幽灵子弹索命恐慌。警政官松东路与热血神枪手郭追受命连手侦破此案。随着调查深入，两人发现阿森纳内黑幕重重，而真相竟隐藏在一个关于正义与人性堕落的惊人诡计之中。

titles.value: 破坏之王 / Love on Delivery

descriptions.value: 外卖员何金银为让他的女神阿丽对他刮目相看，发奋习武，并学了奇怪的招式。胆小怕事的他一次头戴加菲猫面具拯救了阿丽，不料事后被空手道大师段水流领功。银为揭穿真相，最终在擂台使出绝招“无敌风火轮”击败段大师，并抱得美人归。
前特种兵阿龙为调查记者女儿安心在跨境犯罪园区失踪一事，孤身深入这座由金钱与血腥统治的人间炼狱，揭开电信诈骗、地下血库等黑暗内幕。当发现女儿已卷入更大阴谋，暴怒的阿龙化身冷酷杀神，以铁血手段血战罪恶势力，誓要揪出幕后黑手。

titles.value: 猩猩王 / The Mighty Peking Man

descriptions.value: 探险家陈正风（李修贤）受聘赴印度森林搜捕猩猩王，结果误堕娱乐公司老板鲁天（谷峰）的圈套，将猩猩王带往香港表演。同行的「女泰山」阿维（伊芙莲嘉）见猩猩王惨遭捉弄摆布，伤心之余更被鲁天意图强奸。猩猩王睹状狂性大发，追击鲁天至市区，市民一片慌乱，军警如临大敌...全片的特技道具，一丝不苟，猩猩王爬上香港当时最高建筑物康乐大厦的镜头，令观众惊异万分。导演远赴泰国森林取景，还有野性美丽的女泰山伊芙莲嘉演出，令人大饱眼福。

titles.value: 怪谈 / The Case of Disappearances

descriptions.value: 在迷雾村，为人养子的文杰反复梦见同一个噩梦。为了解开身世之谜，他卷入连串神秘的失踪案件中。随着更多村民相继离奇死去，村民更深信不疑千年来的井龙王诅咒。于是，文杰与保安队长连手探寻真相，揭开反派阴谋，最终拯救被危害的无辜村民.

descriptions.value: What surprises and impresses foreign journalists the most when they visit China? Which stories about China are they most eager to share with audiences back home? What expectations do they have for the upcoming China International Import Expo? Tune in to our podcast to discover their experiences, and hear fresh perspectives and untold stories from China!

titles.value: Live promo: Small products, big industry: Meet the Canton Fair's manufacturing 'hidden champions'

descriptions.value: At the 140th Canton Fair on Saturday, CGTN reporter He Jingyi joins Johann Anton Klimmer, a German tool importer and longtime Canton Fair buyer, to explore specialized sectors ranging from hardware and tools to precision components, general machinery, and lighting and electrical products. These specialized SMEs may not be household names, but their smart manufacturing capabilities, comprehensive industrial support and resilient supply chains are a vital source of strength for China's manufacturing sector - and help keep global production moving. What can seemingly ordinary products tell us about the strength of a much larger industry?

titles.value: How China's ocean kingdom makes billions

descriptions.value:
In Southern China, a theme park you've likely never heard of is attracting more annual visitors than Hollywood Universal. The question is, how?
Meet Chimelong Ocean Kingdom. It holds seven Guinness World Records and features the largest aquarium on earth. CGTN's Yu Hongyu dives into the strategy behind the splash to see how a local park created a hundred-billion-dollar opportunity.

titles.value: China's Kungfu theme park: A wild ride back in time

descriptions.value: At Wansuishan Martial Arts City in central China’s Kaifeng, Henan Province, you’re not just a visitor - you’re part of the story. Every segment in the park is part of an immersive experience rooted in Chinese martial arts and traditional culture. From live matchmaking shows to iron flower performances, from Song Dynasty streets to interactive stages, this uniquely Chinese theme park – with not even one roller coaster or scary ride – was able to record over 24 million visits in 2025.

titles.value: Bizfocus: From myth to reality: How tech brings Eastern imagination to life

descriptions.value:
Ever wondered what China’s version of “Adam and Eve” or “Beauty and the Beast” looks like? While the world’s theme parks are all about Western fairy tales, one Chinese park took a different path—Fantawild brings ancient Eastern myths to life with mind-blowing tech and art.
In this episode of Bizfocus, CGTN’s Xu Yi and her new friends from Pakistan and Bangladesh go for adventure in Fantawild Oriental Heritage in Mianyang, Sichuan. Gods, legends, and the tech behind the magic—all in one epic trip.

Here's why it's working, and what it means for both sides.

titles.value: The green bridge between China & US

descriptions.value:
In 2019, Tesla was running on fumes. Shanghai handed it a lifeline, a gigafactory built in 10 months. Today, that plant produces nearly half of all Teslas using 95% local parts. That same playbook is expanding across green tech, pairing Chinese battery tech with American software. 
When the world's two largest economies build together, clean energy gets cheaper and faster for everyone.

The iPhone in your pocket? A global masterpiece. Apple's supply chain spans the world, with America's design expertise meeting China's manufacturing strength. Precision, speed and scale turn bold ideas into products in your hands. And this goes beyond Apple: cooperation across borders can drive innovation and growth. When the world's two biggest economies click, everyone benefits.

For a thousand years, Jingdezhen's kiln fires have shaped iconic ceramics and a living cultural heritage.
Today, algorithms are joining the craftsmen -- helping piece together broken ceramics and give each piece a digital ID.
In this episode of Living with AI, CGTN reporter He Jingyi explores how AI can help preserve ancient craftsmanship -- and how governance can keep pace when the oldest traditions meet the newest technology.

Auto giant Volkswagen will bring China-developed intelligent and electrified technologies, and next-generation products to markets around the world. And China and Europe can join hands to drive the global auto transition. These are messages from Volkswagen Group CEO Oliver Blume at the #CIIE2026, as he sat down with Ralf Brandstätter, VW's China helm, for an exclusive interview with CGTN's Lily Lyu. The conversation spans tech innovation, China strategy and global auto outlook.

titles.value: China's concert boom: Why Gen Z is filling the stadiums

descriptions.value:
From packed stadium shows to sold-out performances in smaller cities, China's live music scene is expanding rapidly. Young audiences are turning concerts into a cultural routine: traveling across cities, sharing the experience online and building collective memories around live performances.

The boom now extends far beyond the stage, boosting tourism, retail spending and local economies. In this episode of Unboxing China, we explore how concerts are reshaping consumption patterns and becoming a new driver of cultural and urban development.

titles.value: The self-care economy explained: How emotional spending is reshaping consumer trends

descriptions.value:
For months, Chinese social feeds have been filled with "Lao Ji"- a third-person way of saying "me." What began as a slang sign-off, "Love you, Lao Ji. See you tomorrow," now signals a broader shift toward self-care and emotional self-support. It also feeds a  huge market where young consumers are rechanneling budgets toward small, meaningful purchases that support emotional wellbeing.

In this episode of Unboxing China, we trace how a casual phrase turned into a cultural movement, reshaping consumption and mental-health talk.

titles.value: You'll be amazed by Nanjing's fusion of old and new

descriptions.value: Though it may not be as well-known as Beijing or Shanghai, China's eastern city of Nanjing is proud of its glorious past, and many of its old quarters are now some of the city's hottest destinations. From ancient pagodas and futuristic skyscrapers to Buddhist temples, take a look at this snapshot of a multi-faceted city.

titles.value: A Bite of China II Ep.6

descriptions.value: In this much-anticipated sequel to the acclaimed foodie hit, we take an even closer look at the bond between Chinese people and food. Featuring around 150 characters and 300 different delicacies, we stand to witness to the role food plays in life's key moments. In short, this series offers the most flavorful insight into ancient Chinese culture that you are ever going to get!

What did China's most celebrated scholars and poets eat? This documentary follows the trail of famous cultural figures from ancient to modern times, using reenactments to explore the classic dishes that helped define China’s rich culinary history.

In this episode, Tianran He and Eva May venture to Xi'an, an ancient city with over 3000 years of history, capital to 13 Chinese dynasties. But first, our hosts are going to carb load on street food, from glutinous rice cakes and cakes made out of persimmons, to mutton soup with flatbread and the famous biangbiang noodles. They'll also taste the rich history of Xi'an by experiencing a Qin Dynasty-inspired banquet, and try millennia-old dishes such as trout grilled on a ceramic tile and calabash chicken, a Tang Dynasty delicacy.
From the Terracotta Army to the Daming Palace, residence of the Tang emperors, to a dazzling nighttime boulevard that recreates the grandeur of the Tang Dynasty, there's so much to explore in Xi'an. So, get your camera and your stomach ready for CGTN's Foodwise in Xi'an!

The Great Wall of China is a popular tourist destination, but did you know that in Beijing, it's where locals go to unwind? From feasts of tofu made using well-water and fish caught fresh from the reservoir, to bubbling cauldrons of thinly-sliced lamb, the hilly suburbs of Beijing are home to some of the city's best-loved weekend escapes - and they're all by the foot of the Great Wall.

As Hainan moves towards implementing its special customs operation, CGTN's Travelogue is launching a brand-new series, "Fun Guide to China". Set in Hainan, the pilot episode journeys through its cities, mountains, coastlines and rainforests, capturing the vibrant atmosphere of life in the Free Trade Port. From the world's largest stand-alone duty-free mall - a true shopper's paradise, to the laid-back charm of an "Old Dad Tea" restaurant, host Tianran He explores the evolving cityscape of Haikou. On the northeast coast in Wenchang, he joins a local photographer to witness the launch of a Chinese space rocket, before diving into interactive space museums that bring the cosmos within reach. The journey then heads west to Danzhou, where campervans and "mermaids" share the same stage, before reaching Wanning on the east coast, where Tianran catches waves at one of China's most famous surfing hotspots.
Ten outdoor enthusiasts take on the world through various sports ---- from marathons to cycling ---- experiencing  geography, culture, history, and the spirit of athletics.

In Yongchun, China, Kleber explores the origins of White Crane kungfu and its effect on the martial arts world. He learns how its blocks and strikes were inspired by animal movements, and how acupuncture points can be used to deadly effect. After training his grip and finger strength with wooden sticks, he travels to Beijing for an introduction to Goju-ryu karate, and discovers striking similarities with White Crane.

Wuyi rock tea, nurtured in the mineral-rich cliffs of the Wuyi Mountains, is a distinctive oolong embodying a unique "rock rhyme" (yan yun) - a taste of nature's harmony. More than a beverage, teas like Da Hong Pao invite mindful appreciation, reflecting centuries of tradition and a philosophy of patience in their complex roasted notes and enduring aftertaste. Discover the terroir, meticulous processing, and the spirit of Chinese tea culture within these exceptional leaves.

When it comes to Mongolian, most people will think of grasslands, horse racing. In fact, the camel is the king of five livestock of nomadic people. Camel is the meritorious figure in the vast desert on the Silk Road. In this episode, we go to Alashan: Camel Town in China, to experience the life of Mongolian people and camels in desert. Milking, delivering milk and collecting camels, also has a thrilling journey to pick up the newborn baby camel. We deeply feel the profound feeling between the camel raiser and their camels.

Shanxi in north China is almost entirely covered with mountains. But the principal force that has sculpted this striking landscape out of the Taihang Mountains is the river that more than any other has shaped Chinese civilization - the Yellow River.
